description: This file implements the class MessageControlImplementation, which provides message control functionalities including attaching/detaching clients, enabling/disabling message categories, and dispatching messages. It also includes a singleton for message settings and handles message collection callbacks.

classes.name: MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class that loads message settings upon instantiation.

classes.name: MessageControlImplementation
classes.description: Implements message control operations such as attach, detach, enable, disable, and message dispatching, following interfaces Exchange::IMessageControl and Exchange::IMessageControl::ICollect.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for message collection; manages thread state accordingly.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific message category/module type.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Retrieves current message control settings as an iterator.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Internal method to wait for message updates and invoke the callback with message data.
